measurement_note: Size is B, the bit length of K. Every tier permits digits 0 through 9, including leading zeros. The accepted contribution formula uses O(B) binary modular exponentiation; the correct slower control recomputes each selected power-of-two factor from the base in O(B^2) time while supporting the full legal K domain.
